test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The art of effective speaking
solution: The correct answer is '**Elocution**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Elocution**'. • It means 'the ability to speak clearly, correctly and without a strong accent'. (श्रेष्‍ठ वक्तृत्‍व कला) • *Example: I need more training in order to improve my **elocution**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Elocution.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Extempore**: spoken, done, or written without any prior preparation or thought. (बिना पूर्व तैयारी के बोला, किया या लिखा गया; तात्कालिक) • **Allocation**: the action or process of allocating or sharing out something. (आवंटन; धनराशि आदि का बँटवारा) • **Impromptu**: (done) without being prepared or organized. [बिना तैयारी या व्‍यवस्‍था के (किया गया), आशु या तत्‍काल (आयोजित)] 1a3:T563, The correct answer is **'To feel lost or confused'.**
